name: Deirdre E. Ostrowski
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Deirdre E. Ostrowski is an attorney who represents clients in the Denver, Colorado area. Deirdre Ostrowski is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Deirdre Ostrowski chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended University of Denver Sturm College of Law and graduated in 2007. Deirdre Ostrowski passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2007.
She represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues in Colorado. She also represents clients with Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Deirdre Ostrowski has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
